judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A pleasant, clearly structured daytime sky with decent cloud contrast, but it lacks the light or composition to make it especially striking.
strengths: Crisp white clouds against saturated blue
Layered lower cloud band adds depth
Good contrast between sunlit tops and shaded bases
weaknesses: Composition feels like a random sky crop
Lower clouds are cut off at frame edge
